title: Noren wave curtain
text: Noren wave curtain. Love love love this noren.  It's beautifully sewn and finished.  I was surprised to find that not all norens are professionally finished and have raw edges and cheap material.  This one is NOT one of those.  The colors are just as noted in the photograph.  Now... having said that... I want to note that is one is a bit thinner than some I have.  It is longer too.  The sew at the top of split is shorter than some I have as well... only about 8 or 9 inches from the top - just eyeballing it.  In case that matters to you.  In my personal opinion they add a nice touch to a door way or over a window.  I am very happy with my purchase.  It arrived quickly (I have prime) and in great condition along with some other items I had purchased.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
